subject: ggmap pdf export; extent to fill

messages.author: ddc91303cb21ac62
messages.subject: ggmap pdf export; extent to fill
parts:
Hi all,

I am having some trouble outputting a figure from ggmap and getting it to fill the actual size of the pdf specified. "test.pdf" and "test2.pdf" should illustrate what I am talking about. How do I extent the plot?

Thanks in advance!

Sam

library(ggplot2)
library(mapproj)
library(ggmap)

hdf <- get_map()
pdf.plt<-ggmap(hdf, extent = 'panel')
## Looks good
ggsave(pdf.plt, file="test.pdf", width=11, height=8)
## Just adds white space
ggsave(pdf.plt, file="test2.pdf", width=20, height=8)
